function: Conditional-GAN synthesis of massive MIMO channel impulse responses from measurements, augmenting training of a network that predicts path loss and RMS delay spread (p. 1-4)
system: Measured 8x16 massive MIMO (16 Tx, 8 Rx antennas) in a subway tunnel, 3.5 GHz, 160 MHz bandwidth; no RIS (p. 2)
method: Conditional Wasserstein GAN with gradient penalty (adversarial, Adam, 500 epochs) on measured CIRs; supervised 3-hidden-layer BPNN predicts path loss and delay spread (p. 3-4)
data_channel: Own 3.5 GHz measurements in a Shanghai Metro tunnel (91 positions, 910 samples, 8x16 antenna pairs); also 3640 Wireless InSite ray-tracing samples (p. 2, 4-5)
test_conditions: BPNN tested on 26 held-out positions; also on a new tunnel scenario (3.68 m, 4.50 m, 5.6 GHz) absent from the four training scenarios (p. 4-5)
baselines: Non-learned noise injection and random-shift augmentation [18]; BPNN trained on measured data only; no earlier GAN channel model or other learned predictor compared (p. 4)
metrics: Path loss and RMS-DS prediction RMSE and MAPE; generated-versus-measured power delay profile, RMS delay spread, and angular-spread statistics (p. 4-5)
q1_support: p. 4: "The on-site measured 910 samples are divided into training set and test set"; the cGAN and the BPNN use the authors' own 3.5 GHz tunnel measurements (p. 2).
q2_support: p. 5: "predicts the channel statistics with respect to the Rx positions under a new scenario of (3.68m, 4.50m, 5.6GHz)"; training used four other Wireless InSite scenarios (radius, width, 3.5 or 5.0 GHz).
q3_support: p. 4: "existing channel data augmentation methods [18] including noise injection and random shift are also given as a comparison baseline"; both are non-learned, and no earlier learned GAN channel model or predictor is compared (the measured-only BPNN is the pipeline without the cGAN).
q4_support: p. 4: "The constructed BPNN has 3 hidden layers, each with 12, 24 and 24 neurons"; this is architecture only, with no operations, parameter count, complexity order or runtime for the cGAN or the BPNN.
q5_support: p. 4: "The on-site measured 910 samples are divided into training set and test set"; the data are the authors' own measurements with no release link or DOI, so q5 rests on the measured-data clause.
notes: The cGAN synthesizes the channel and the BPNN predicts path loss and RMS-DS, which is prediction and synthesis of the channel (area 2). q1 and q5 rest on the authors' own measured data, which has no release link; q5 follows the measured-data clause of the criterion, so the reviewer should confirm that reading. The second experiment uses commercial Wireless InSite ray tracing, not DeepMIMO. q3 is 0 because no earlier learned baseline is compared. Table II and III values were read from the page image.
